name: Chicken Mediterranean For Two
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy-duty zip-lock plastic bag
Cook this chicken mixture in a large skillet over medium-high heat for about 8 minutes or until the chicken is done
Remove from skillet and set aside
To the empty skillet , add the tomatoes and their juice , olives , parsley , basil , and oregano
Reduce heat , simmer , stirring often for about 7 minutes
Sprinkle with the feta cheese , remove from heat
Cover and let stand for 5 minutes so the cheese can melt a little
Pour over cooked , hot pasta and serve immediately
